steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Both Christianity and Islam see the family as the basic unit of society. Families provide stability, love, education and the passing on of faith to the next generation. | RS Exam Tips — The Nature and Purpose of Families: 1. For The Nature and Purpose of Families questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Nature and Purpose of Families to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
